seller_or_subject: CheckThat.ai — Free/Plus plan break-even at $967/month revenue
what: A third-party analysis calculates that the break-even point between Payhip's Free plan (5% fee) and Plus plan ($29/mo + 2% fee) is $967/month in revenue.
verbatim_snippet: "Upgrade when your monthly revenue consistently exceeds $967. At this point, the Plus plan's $29 subscription plus 2% fees costs the same as the Free plan's 5% fees."
notes: Math checks out: $967 × 0.05 = $48.35; $29 + ($967 × 0.02) = $48.34. Verified by calculation. Original ID: C7.
